meta.name: FLOOR PLAN 1
meta.note: Scale 33.6 px/m from the 6 x 12 m stage (403 x 201 px outline to outline), checked on the 3 x 3 m stage extension (101 px) and 3 x 3 m booths (100.5 px pitch). Origin: hall inner top-left at (1,1). 154 goods (the legend has no food class, so none is fnb); 136 tables, 744 chairs (544 at tables, 200 in audience rows): each of the 136 tilted tables is fitted to its drawn outline (kind table, with its size and tilt) and keeps its 4 chairs (kind chair, table N); the 2 x 100 audience chairs have table null; 6 walls (door wall, 2 vestibule, 3 seating enclosure). Door A is the exit and Door B the entrance: Door B opens into the vestibule that holds the foyer entrance door, Door A into the open foyer that holds the foyer exit door. kids holds the two 10 x 10 audience chair grids (200 chairs). 27 hollow square wall pillars are pilasters of kind block. J1 to J4 and K1 to K10 stand in the lobby, outside the hall polygon, and are kept because they are drawn. The printed D6 appears twice (a D row and a C column). The DOORPRIZE BOOTH, 3 BLOCKED tiles, 4 DECOR boxes and the ENTRANCE box are fixtures; drop ENTRANCE if it is a walkable zone. Left out: the north bay doors, the west and east emergency doors (not on the door wall), the thin inner layout rectangle, the lobby walls (the lobby polygon edge is the wall), the EMERGENCY EXIT label. Hall polygon is the outer wall inner face.
